purpose: User-requested illustrative avatar for Phạm Duy Khiêm
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one square personal profile avatar for the Asinu mobile app, designed as an illustrative avatar for Phạm Duy Khiêm, a close friend of Dương Anh Đức.
Subject: one friendly young adult Vietnamese man, short neatly styled black hair, warm brown eyes, relaxed natural smile, a simple casual teal overshirt over a light neutral T-shirt. This is an original invented illustrated character, not a claimed likeness of a real person. Do not portray him as a doctor.
Style: refined, appealing 3D character portrait with gentle realistic proportions, subtle skin shading and crisp facial details, warm and approachable rather than childlike or exaggerated.
Composition: centered head-and-shoulders portrait, straight-on view with slight natural head angle, both shoulders included. Keep the full hair and face comfortably inside the central circular crop safe area with space around the head. The face should remain recognizable when displayed as a small 48pt circular avatar.
Background: simple clean pale mint background, soft and unobtrusive, matching the app's teal palette.
Lighting: soft diffused studio daylight, clear eyes, calm friendly mood.
Constraints: single person only; no text, initials, names, logos, watermark, badges, stethoscope, medical clothing, border, circular frame, or additional objects. Opaque background, square image.
